threshold_selection: Among observed scores from the 67 class-labelled in-app seed entries, choose cutoffs minimizing absolute distance from N/3 and 2N/3 cumulative counts; ties choose smaller scores. Frozen before benchmark execution.
validation: 36 runs x 60 attempts; score, cutoffs, branch tier, and operation_sequence cross-checked against the exact seed-derived scores.
interpretation_limit: PSR is distinct outputs accepted by the current class-structure predicates divided by attempts. These predicates are not proof of parser acceptance or exploitability. IMR is structurally rejected adaptive-mutation attempts divided by adaptive-mutation attempts.

audit_reconciliation.PSR_definition: Distinct accepted output entries after per-call deduplication divided by all attempts; repeats across category/profile calls remain separate context-specific output entries.
